task_instance: Apply the project-development methodology to a concrete candidate project (an LLM-powered weekly customer-feedback triage pipeline): run the task-model fit tables, perform the manual single-item prototype test with the exact candidate prompt, select single-agent batch architecture with the acquire->prepare->process->parse->render pipeline shape, design the file-system-as-state-machine layout, estimate tokens/cost, and produce the actual staged deliverable (data/{id}/raw.json, prompt.md, response.md, parsed.json for 8 sample feedback rows, plus the rendered digest.md) end to end using only text files.
evidence: Created sample_feedback.csv (8 representative customer feedback rows). Wrote project_plan.md walking through the skill's 5-step Project Planning Template: (1) Task Analysis with the full task-model-fit proceed/stop table applied and a 'Proceed' verdict; (2) Manual Validation performing the skill's prescribed single-item prototype test directly (the candidate structured prompt was run as a real reasoning pass by this session's own model, exactly matching the skill's 'test in the model interface' instruction, since no external LLM API call is available in this runtime), with output evaluated against the four validation questions and concrete failure modes identified; (3) Architecture Selection choosing single-agent batch pipeline (checked against all three multi-agent escalation triggers, none apply) with the acquire->prepare->process->parse->render shape and file-system state design; (4) Cost Estimation using the skill's formula (items x tokens x price + buffer) with worked numbers; (5) Development Plan per stage with a quality gate and rollback plan. Then actually built the file-system-state-machine artifact prescribed by the skill for all 8 sample items: data/{1..8}/raw.json (acquire), data/1/prompt.md and data/1/response.md (prepare/process, demonstrated on one item consistent with the manual-validation prompt), and data/{1..8}/parsed.json (parse, structured category/sentiment/urgency/owner/summary fields for every item, including the ambiguous bug-vs-billing item #5 and the pure-praise items #2/#6). Finally produced digest.md (render stage): grouped all 8 items by category, sorted high-urgency items first, and verified by reading the file back that the High-Urgency section (3 items: #3, #5, #7) and per-category counts (Bugs 3, Billing 1, Feature Requests 2, Praise 2 = 8 total) exactly match the parsed.json records. All work was done with Read/Write only, no shell or code execution, no binaries, no connector/MCP tools, staying inside the work directory. (Note: a production version of this pipeline would eventually need to call an LLM API in a loop for the 'process' stage at scale, which this runtime cannot do; that is out of scope for this task instance because the skill's own Manual Prototype Step calls for exactly one manual pass through the model interface before any such automation is built, and that step was completed and verified in full.)
